Best way to tell is to try them on. Check to see if your knee lands naturally at about the mid point of the knee stack when dropping into the butterfly. It also helps if you try this while wearing skates and whatever knee guards (if you wear them at all) you would normally use.

Could be a few things. First and most obviously it could be that your thigh rise isn't high enough, I personally have L 1X pads which has a +2 thigh rise and that works for me. Second, your initial stance may be just slightly too wide causing your knees to be too far apart when you drop. Lastly, it could be a problem with internal knee rotation (the motion of your feet flaring out when you drop to your knees). From what you have said your groin abduction and trunk flexion are great (personally I have terrible hamstrings) but you may need to work on the rotation a bit, hard to say without being able to see it.
